_comment: Machine-readable maturity index for the cross-language enforcement matrix. Values: proven | beta | unsafe | unavailable. Consumed by src/utils/maturity-check.ts.

java.reason: All four tools wired into L1/L2 gate; production-grade rulesets

typescript.reason: Comprehensive static rules + format check wired into L1 gate

rust.reason: cargo clippy -D warnings wired into L1; pedantic deny rules in clippy.toml for hexagonal archetype

go.reason: Full linter suite (gocyclo/gosec/errcheck/staticcheck) wired into L1 gate

python.reason: Comprehensive rules (complexity/unused/security) wired into L1 gate

kotlin.reason: detekt is the de facto Kotlin static-analysis tool; Gradle/Maven plugins stable, severity mapping still maturing vs Java Checkstyle/PMD

java.reason: pitest is the de-facto Java mutation testing standard; stable API, broad adoption

typescript.reason: Stryker 8.x is well-maintained with first-class Vitest integration

rust.reason: cargo-mutants threshold gating is unstable; passes on some versions, fails silently on others

go.reason: go-mutesting is abandoned upstream and hangs on Go 1.23 module graphs

python.reason: mutmut runtime can exceed 6h on mid-sized codebases; no reliable timeout-per-mutant control

kotlin.reason: pitest operates on JVM bytecode; Kotlin compilation transparent but not yet fixture-verified

java.reason: pact-jvm has stable consumer + provider verification; widely adopted in Spring Boot

typescript.reason: Pact JS library is well-maintained with Node 18+ support

rust.reason: pact_consumer for Rust is a community crate; provider verification is experimental

go.reason: Pact Go SDK wraps the Rust core via FFI; occasional FFI panics on newer Go runtimes

python.reason: pact-python lacks provider-verification parity with pact-jvm; V4 migration in progress

kotlin.reason: pact-jvm works on compiled Kotlin; consumer/provider flow not yet fixture-verified

java.reason: JaCoCo is the standard Java coverage tool with Gradle and Maven integration

typescript.reason: vitest --coverage with c8 is stable and fast

rust.reason: cargo-tarpaulin produces reliable line/branch coverage on stable Rust

go.reason: Built-in Go coverage is stable; no external tooling required

python.reason: pytest-cov with coverage.py is the standard Python coverage stack

kotlin.reason: Kotlin-native coverage (JetBrains Kover); Gradle-native, report shape differs from JaCoCo so thresholds need validation

java.reason: ArchUnit has stable API and is widely used in Spring Boot monoliths

typescript.reason: eslint-plugin-boundaries provides reliable import boundary checking

rust.reason: cargo-deny and clippy provide reliable static checks for Rust

go.reason: depguard (golangci-lint) provides reliable static checks for Go, consistent with M22b pattern

python.reason: import-linter enforces import contracts; ruff handles style

kotlin.reason: ArchUnit inspects compiled JVM bytecode so it works on Kotlin; not yet exercised across Kotlin fixtures

java.reason: RestAssured integration tests are widely used for Spring Boot E2E

typescript.reason: Playwright is the industry standard for browser E2E testing

rust.reason: No E2E testing equivalent for Rust CLI projects; use integration level instead

go.reason: No E2E testing equivalent for Go CLI projects; use integration level instead

java.reason: OWASP DependencyCheck is the standard Java dependency audit tool

typescript.reason: npm audit is built into npm and reliable

rust.reason: cargo audit is the standard Rust advisory check

go.reason: govulncheck is the official Go vulnerability scanner from the Go team

python.reason: pip-audit is stable and maintained by PyPA

kotlin.reason: JVM dependency scanning is language-agnostic; pending Kotlin fixture verification

java.reason: stable JUnit5 integration in Spring Boot stacks

typescript.reason: official cucumber-js with native TS support is stable on Node 18+

python.reason: pytest-bdd scenarios() reuses pytest fixtures cleanly

go.reason: godog v0.14 stable but generic step bindings rough

rust.reason: cucumber-rs 0.20 stable for sync; async World still evolving

typescript.reason: stylelint 16+ enforces color-no-hex and design-token discipline; widely adopted in ts-frontend-spa stacks (haben pattern, #352)

java.reason: jqwik property-based fuzzing runs in JUnit5; 30-min nightly budget per spec T4

typescript.reason: fast-check property testing integrates with Vitest; nightly budget

rust.reason: cargo-fuzz (libFuzzer) is the standard Rust fuzz harness; requires nightly toolchain

go.reason: Go 1.18+ native fuzzing; go-fuzz as fallback; 30-min nightly budget

python.reason: atheris (Google libFuzzer Python bindings) is the recommended Python fuzzer; nightly

kotlin.reason: jqwik runs on JVM bytecode so it works with Kotlin, same as Java; a dedicated Kotlin branch in _nightly.yml.ejs is not yet wired (#1724 follow-up)

java.reason: OWASP ZAP baseline (T2) and full scan (T4 nightly) against ephemeral container

typescript.reason: OWASP ZAP baseline (T2) and full scan (T4 nightly)

rust.reason: OWASP ZAP baseline against service-archetype Rust binaries only; cli/lib: unavailable

go.reason: OWASP ZAP baseline against service-archetype Go binaries only; cli/lib: unavailable

python.reason: OWASP ZAP baseline (T2) and full scan (T4 nightly) for service/batch archetypes

kotlin.reason: OWASP ZAP scans a running HTTP service; language-agnostic, already wired identically to Java

java.reason: license-maven-plugin checks third-party licenses against an allow-list at T2

typescript.reason: license-checker (npm) enumerates package licenses; T2 gate with deny-list

rust.reason: cargo-deny [licenses] table enforces SPDX allow/deny list; T2 gate

go.reason: go-licenses (Google) enumerates module licenses; T2 gate

python.reason: pip-licenses enumerates installed package licenses; T2 gate

kotlin.reason: Same JVM build-tool license reporting as Java (Gradle/Maven); a dedicated Kotlin branch in 02-pr-extended.yml.ejs is not yet wired (#1724 follow-up)

java.reason: cyclonedx-maven-plugin generates CycloneDX SBOM at T3 release; wired in existing nightly

typescript.reason: npm sbom (npm 8+) or cyclonedx-npm for CycloneDX output at T3

rust.reason: cargo-cyclonedx generates CycloneDX SBOM for Rust workspace artifacts

go.reason: syft (Anchore) closes the Go SBOM gap — used by 05-release.yml.ejs T3 and 06-nightly.yml.ejs T4

python.reason: cyclonedx-bom (Python) generates CycloneDX SBOM from pip environment at T3

kotlin.reason: Same JVM build-tool SBOM generation as Java (Gradle/Maven); a dedicated Kotlin branch in 05-release.yml.ejs is not yet wired (#1724 follow-up)

java.reason: cosign keyless sign-blob over JARs and native-image binaries at T3; Sigstore OIDC

typescript.reason: cosign sign-blob over npm tarballs and cli binaries; Sigstore OIDC

rust.reason: cosign sign-blob over cargo-dist binary artifacts; Sigstore OIDC

go.reason: cosign sign for container images (service); sign-blob for goreleaser binaries (cli)

python.reason: cosign sign-blob over wheels (twine) and pyinstaller binaries; Sigstore OIDC

kotlin.reason: cosign keyless sign-blob over JARs at T3; Sigstore OIDC — language-agnostic, already wired identically to Java

java.reason: GitHub native provenance (L1/L2) + slsa-github-generator hermetic builder (L3) at T3

typescript.reason: GitHub native provenance (L1/L2) + slsa-github-generator (L3) at T3

rust.reason: GitHub native provenance (L1/L2) + slsa-github-generator (L3) at T3

go.reason: GitHub native provenance (L1/L2) + slsa-github-generator (L3) at T3

python.reason: GitHub native provenance (L1/L2) + slsa-github-generator (L3) at T3

kotlin.reason: GitHub native provenance (L1/L2) + slsa-github-generator (L3) at T3 — language-agnostic, already wired identically to Java

java.reason: Trivy HIGH+CRITICAL (L2) / MEDIUM+ (L3) blocking at T2 when Dockerfile changed; T3 rescan

typescript.reason: Trivy container scan at T2/T3 for service-archetype TS projects

rust.reason: Trivy container scan at T2/T3 for service-archetype Rust projects

go.reason: Trivy container scan at T2/T3 for service-archetype Go projects

python.reason: Trivy container scan at T2/T3 for service-archetype Python projects

kotlin.reason: Trivy HIGH+CRITICAL container scan against the built Docker image; language-agnostic Dockerfile-based scan, already wired identically to Java

java.reason: Gitleaks diff-scan at T1; full history scan at T3 and T4 nightly

typescript.reason: Gitleaks diff-scan at T1; full history scan at T3 and T4 nightly

rust.reason: Gitleaks diff-scan at T1; full history scan at T3 and T4 nightly

go.reason: Gitleaks diff-scan at T1; full history scan at T3 and T4 nightly

python.reason: Gitleaks diff-scan at T1; full history scan at T3 and T4 nightly

kotlin.reason: Gitleaks diff-scan at T1; full history scan at T3 and T4 nightly — language-agnostic, already wired identically to Java

typescript.reason: @axe-core/playwright 4.11+ ships a stable AxeBuilder; wcag2a+wcag2aa tag set is the industry baseline (INV-61, #349)

python.reason: axe-playwright-python wraps the same axe-core rules but the API surface is small and tag selection less ergonomic than the TS binding; now generated (#1149) via run_axe.py wrapper for frontend-spa/backend-web-db archetypes

rust.reason: No browser surface for Rust CLI/embedded archetypes — a11y is a UI-layer concern

go.reason: No browser surface for Go CLI/server archetypes — a11y is a UI-layer concern

java.reason: Server-side Java archetypes have no rendered UI; pair with a TS frontend lane for a11y coverage
